name: Mirror Therapy
source:
''What this mirror reflects is the most important person in your life!''
The player is a ghost who works in a hospital. To cure a patient who is trapped in his delusion, you have to act as if you were his 'lover'. However, the patient is heavily yandere. If you make a mistake...
